name: Inspect files before opening a document

elements.name: Inspect a part file before opening it

steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
a folder contains a saved part with a preview and recorded metadata
the user presses Control+O and navigates to that folder
the user selects the saved part
the part row is selected and the file name field identifies it
the preview displays the part
the Options pane displays Model State and Design View controls
the user chooses Details
the preview remains visible
the details include the file type, modification date, size, author and part number
the user cancels the Open dialog
the previously active part document remains displayed

elements.name: Inspect a drawing after selecting a part

steps.name: the Open dialog is displaying a folder containing a saved part and drawing with previews
the saved part is selected and its details are displayed
the user selects the drawing
the file name field identifies the drawing
the preview displays the drawing sheet
the Details pane identifies the drawing and displays its metadata
the user chooses Options
the drawing options include Load in Defer Mode and Skip all unresolved files
the user cancels the Open dialog
the dialog closes without opening the selected drawing

elements.name: Open a saved drawing alongside an existing part

steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
a saved drawing with a sheet, border and view is available and not already open
the user presses Control+O and selects the drawing
the user chooses Open
the Open dialog closes
the drawing becomes active in a new document tab
the drawing sheet and border are displayed
the drawing browser lists the sheet and a view
the part document tab remains available

elements.name: Toggle express loading for an assembly before opening

steps.name: the Open dialog is open in the MCAD Software
a saved assembly with a preview is selected
the Options pane displays Load in Express Mode unchecked
Model State, Design View and Position View controls are displayed
the user selects Load in Express Mode
Design View and Position View become unavailable
Model State remains available
the user clears Load in Express Mode
Design View and Position View become available again
the assembly preview remains displayed

elements.name: Switch navigation panes without changing the selected file

steps.name: the Open dialog is open in the MCAD Software
its project navigation pane shows libraries and recent folders
a saved part is selected with its file name and preview displayed
the user switches to the system folder navigation pane
common system locations are displayed in the navigation pane
the selected part, file name and preview remain displayed
the user switches back to the project navigation pane
libraries and recent folders are displayed again
the selected part, file name and preview remain displayed

elements.name: Switch between details and thumbnail file views

steps.name: the Open dialog is open in the MCAD Software
a saved part with a preview is selected in the detailed file list
the user chooses the thumbnail view control
files are displayed as thumbnail tiles
the selected part remains selected with its file name and preview displayed
the user chooses the details view control
files are displayed in rows with Name, Date modified, Type and Size columns
the selected part remains selected with its file name and preview displayed

elements.name: Reverse the size sort without losing the selected file

steps.name: the Open dialog is open in the MCAD Software
the detailed file list contains files of different sizes
a saved part is selected with its file name and preview displayed
the file list is sorted by decreasing size
the user clicks the Size column header
the file list is sorted by increasing size
the selected part remains selected with its file name and preview displayed

elements.name: Inspect and dismisses available design views for a part

steps.name: the Open dialog is open in the MCAD Software
a saved part with named design views is selected
its Design View field displays Last Active
the user opens the Design View list
Last Active, the primary view, and the part's named design views are displayed
the part preview remains visible
the user presses Escape
the Design View list closes
the Design View field still displays Last Active
the Open dialog remains open

elements.name: Inspect selected part properties without opening the part

steps.name: the Open dialog is open in the MCAD Software
a saved part with a preview and metadata is selected
the user chooses the selected file's properties link
a separate properties window opens for that part
its General tab shows file type, location, size and file dates
the user chooses the Summary tab
fields including Title, Subject, Author, Category and Comments are displayed
the user chooses the Project tab
fields including Part Number, Description, Revision Number and Designer are displayed
the user chooses the Thumbnail tab
the saved part preview is displayed
the user cancels the properties window without editing
the Open dialog is displayed again
the same part remains selected with its file name and preview displayed

elements.name: Activate an already open part through the Open dialog

steps.name: a saved part is open in the MCAD Software
a different drawing document is active
the open part's exact file location is known
the user presses Control+O and chooses the already open part at that location
the user chooses Open
the Open dialog closes
the existing part document tab becomes active
no additional document tab is created
the drawing tab remains available

elements.name: Deferred drawing loading clears and disables unresolved-file skipping

steps.name: the Open dialog is open in the MCAD Software
a saved drawing is selected with its Options pane displayed
Load in Defer Mode is unchecked
Skip all unresolved files is checked
the user selects Load in Defer Mode
Skip all unresolved files is unavailable
the user clears Load in Defer Mode
Skip all unresolved files is available and unchecked
the selected drawing and its preview remain displayed

elements.name: Reset drawing options when switching selected files

steps.name: the Open dialog is open in the MCAD Software
two saved drawings are visible in the same folder
the first drawing is selected in the Options pane
Load in Defer Mode is unchecked for the first drawing
the user selects Load in Defer Mode
the user selects the second drawing
the second drawing is selected and its file name is displayed
Load in Defer Mode is unchecked for the second drawing
the user selects the first drawing again
Load in Defer Mode is unchecked
the drawing remains selected without being opened

elements.name: Open a drawing with updates deferred

steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
a saved drawing with a sheet, border and views is available and not already open
the deferred-update information message is enabled
the user opens the drawing's file selection dialog
the user selects the drawing and enable Load in Defer Mode
the user chooses Open
an information message states that drawing updates are deferred
it indicates that defer status must change to update views and associate added annotations
the message offers a display preference and an OK control
the user acknowledges the message
the drawing opens in a new active document tab
the sheet, border and saved view geometry are displayed
the drawing browser shows the sheet and a view
drawing view creation commands in the ribbon are unavailable
the original part tab remains available

elements.name: Open an assembly in express mode and load it fully

steps.name: a drawing document is active in the MCAD Software
a saved assembly with visible components is available and not already open
the user opens the file selection dialog
the user selects the assembly and enable Load in Express Mode
the user chooses Open
the assembly opens in a new active document tab
its component geometry is visible in the viewport
the assembly browser lists its components
the assembly ribbon offers Load Full
the drawing tab remains available
the user chooses Load Full
the assembly remains active with its component geometry displayed
Load Full is no longer displayed in the ribbon
Finish and Simplify are visible and enabled as ribbon commands; neither is invoked

elements.name: Navigate between a file's folder and its parent

steps.name: the Open dialog is open in the MCAD Software
a saved part with a preview is selected in a child folder
the user chooses Up to the parent folder
the parent folder contents are displayed
the child folder is highlighted in the list
the file name field retains the part name
the preview area shows a placeholder for the selected folder
the user chooses Back
the child folder contents are displayed again
the file name field and preview display the previously selected part
the user chooses Forward
the parent folder contents are displayed again
the child folder is highlighted

elements.name: Open a selected folder while a file name is retained

steps.name: the Open dialog is open in the MCAD Software
the file name field retains the name of a part in a child folder
the parent folder displays that child folder
the user selects the child folder in the file list
the user chooses Open
the dialog remains open and displays the child folder contents
the file name field still contains the part name
the part preview is displayed
no new document tab is created

elements.name: Open a different drawing by double-clicking its row

steps.name: an assembly document is active in the MCAD Software
the Open dialog displays two saved drawings in a folder
the first drawing is selected
the second drawing has a sheet, border and saved views and is not already open
the user double-clicks the second drawing's row
the Open dialog closes
the second drawing opens in a new active document tab
its sheet, border and saved views are displayed
the assembly tab remains available

elements.name: Reopen the dialog after cancelling a folder change

steps.name: a drawing was opened from a child folder in the MCAD Software
that drawing remains active
the Open dialog is showing the same child folder
the user navigates up to its parent folder
the user cancels the Open dialog
the drawing remains active
the user reopens the Open dialog in the same session
it displays the original child folder
the file name field identifies the previously opened drawing
the drawing preview is displayed

elements.name: Maximize and restores the Open dialog

steps.name: the Open dialog is open in the MCAD Software as a restored window
a saved part with a preview is selected
the user maximizes the Open dialog
the dialog expands to fill the available screen
the file list, navigation pane, preview and bottom actions remain visible
the selected part, file name and preview remain displayed
the user restores the Open dialog
it returns to its previous window size and position
the selected part, file name and preview remain displayed

elements.name: Inspect and dismisses file-type choices

steps.name: the Open dialog is open in the MCAD Software
a saved part is selected with its name and preview displayed
the user opens the file-type filter list
the list offers a combined native-document filter
it includes separate filters for assemblies, drawings, parts and presentations
additional file-format filters are visible
the user dismisses the list without choosing a different filter
the previous file-type filter remains displayed
the selected part name and preview remain displayed

elements.name: Inspect and dismisses the file display menu

steps.name: the Open dialog is open in the MCAD Software
files are displayed in Details view
a part name and preview are displayed
the user opens the file display menu
the menu offers extra large, large, medium and small icon sizes
it offers List, Details, Tiles and Content views
Details is indicated as the current view
the user dismisses the menu without choosing another view
the file list remains in Details view
the part name and preview remain displayed

elements.name: Change the selected document in thumbnail view

steps.name: the Open dialog in the MCAD Software displays a saved drawing and a saved part as thumbnails
the drawing thumbnail is selected with its sheet preview displayed
the Options pane shows the drawing loading choices
the user selects the part thumbnail
the part thumbnail is highlighted
the file name field identifies the part
the separate preview displays the part geometry
the Options pane displays Model State and Design View controls
the dialog remains open

elements.name: Inspect a file context menu without opening the document

steps.name: the Open dialog in the MCAD Software displays a saved part as a thumbnail
the part is selected with its file name and preview displayed
the user right-clicks the part thumbnail
a context menu appears with Open, Copy, Rename and Properties choices
the part name and preview remain displayed behind the menu
the user clicks an empty area of the file list
the context menu closes
the selected-item count is cleared
the dialog remains open with the part name and preview displayed

elements.name: Select multiple drawing files and return to one

steps.name: the Open dialog in the MCAD Software displays two adjacent saved drawings as thumbnails
each drawing has a saved sheet preview
the user drags a selection rectangle from empty list space across both thumbnails
both drawing thumbnails are selected
the status area reports two selected items
the file name field contains both drawing names in quotes
the separate preview area displays a placeholder
individual drawing loading options are not displayed
the user selects one of the drawing thumbnails
only that drawing is selected
the file name field identifies that drawing
its sheet preview and drawing loading options are displayed
the Open dialog remains open

elements.name: Open two selected drawings together

steps.name: the MCAD Software has an existing document open
two saved drawings with available references and visible saved view geometry are not already open
the Open dialog displays both drawings as thumbnails
the user selects both drawing thumbnails with a selection rectangle
the user chooses Open
the Open dialog closes
both drawings are available in separate document tabs
one of the drawings is active with its sheet and saved geometry displayed
the existing document tab remains available
the user selects the other drawing tab
that drawing becomes active and its sheet is displayed

elements.name: Reopen a selection of drawings already in the session

steps.name: two saved drawings are already open in separate tabs in the MCAD Software
one of those drawings is active
the Open dialog displays their exact saved files
the user selects both drawings and chooses Open
the Open dialog closes
both existing drawing tabs remain available
one of those drawing tabs becomes active
no duplicate tab is created for either drawing

elements.name: Open a selection containing an open and a closed drawing

steps.name: a saved drawing is already open in a tab in the MCAD Software
a second saved drawing with available references is not open
the Open dialog displays the exact files for both drawings
the user selects both drawings and chooses Open
the Open dialog closes
the previously open drawing retains its existing tab without a duplicate
the second drawing opens in a new tab
the second drawing is active with its sheet displayed
